---
title: "Reader paths"
---

Nobody starts at lesson one. Pick the route that matches why you are here.

## I am planning an experiment

*About to generate data; nothing has been cut yet* · Assumes: No analysis background needed

Read this before the tissue is cut. Every other route on this site assumes the design is already fixed, and most of what goes wrong later was decided here.

1. [Designing the experiment before there is data](lessons/L01-designing-the-experiment-before-there-is-data.qmd)
1. [From block to matrix: the steps that constrain your analysis](lessons/L02-from-block-to-matrix-the-steps-that-constrain-yo.qmd)
1. [Panel design and the codebook](lessons/L03-panel-design-and-the-codebook.qmd)
1. [Platforms and resolution regimes](lessons/L05-platforms-and-resolution-regimes.qmd)
1. [Deconvolution returns proportions, not cells](lessons/L08-deconvolution-returns-proportions-not-cells.qmd)

5 lessons.

## I just got my first run back

*Wet-lab scientist with data and no prior single-cell analysis* · Assumes: You ran the experiment; no Python or R assumed

Starts with what your own bench decisions did to the data, then the three checks that catch most early mistakes.

1. [From block to matrix: the steps that constrain your analysis](lessons/L02-from-block-to-matrix-the-steps-that-constrain-yo.qmd)
1. [What spatial data is, and what it is not](lessons/L04-what-spatial-data-is-and-what-it-is-not.qmd)
1. [Platforms and resolution regimes](lessons/L05-platforms-and-resolution-regimes.qmd)
1. [Coordinate systems, and the flipped axis](lessons/L06-coordinate-systems-and-the-flipped-axis.qmd)
1. [Segmentation is upstream of everything](lessons/L07-segmentation-is-upstream-of-everything.qmd)
1. [The noise floor you were given for free](lessons/L09-the-noise-floor-you-were-given-for-free.qmd)
1. [Plotting spatial data honestly](lessons/L16-plotting-spatial-data-honestly.qmd)

7 lessons.

## I do single-cell analysis and want to learn spatial

*Computational biologist fluent in scanpy or Seurat* · Assumes: Clustering, annotation, integration and differential expression

The longest route, and the one closest to a course. Roughly a third of your existing toolkit transfers unchanged, a third transfers with a twist that will bite you, and a third does not exist in dissociated data at all. The order below is built around that split: what is different, then what generated it, then the familiar steps that behave differently here, then the genuinely new statistics.

1. [Platforms and resolution regimes](lessons/L05-platforms-and-resolution-regimes.qmd)
1. [Coordinate systems, and the flipped axis](lessons/L06-coordinate-systems-and-the-flipped-axis.qmd)
1. [From block to matrix: the steps that constrain your analysis](lessons/L02-from-block-to-matrix-the-steps-that-constrain-yo.qmd)
1. [Segmentation is upstream of everything](lessons/L07-segmentation-is-upstream-of-everything.qmd)
1. [The noise floor you were given for free](lessons/L09-the-noise-floor-you-were-given-for-free.qmd)
1. [Cell typing inherits the reference's blind spots](lessons/L10-cell-typing-inherits-the-reference-s-blind-spots.qmd)
1. [Neighbourhood graphs and niches](lessons/L11-neighbourhood-graphs-and-niches.qmd)
1. [Your neighbours are not independent samples](lessons/L12-your-neighbours-are-not-independent-samples.qmd)
1. [Ligand and receptor is co-expression until proven otherwise](lessons/L13-ligand-and-receptor-is-co-expression-until-prove.qmd)
1. [Section is batch, and batch is confounded with biology](lessons/L14-section-is-batch-and-batch-is-confounded-with-bi.qmd)
1. [When the data does not fit in memory](lessons/L15-when-the-data-does-not-fit-in-memory.qmd)
1. [An analysis someone else can run](lessons/L17-an-analysis-someone-else-can-run.qmd)

12 lessons.

## I am reviewing someone else's spatial paper

*Referee or reader checking a published claim* · Assumes: General familiarity with genomics papers

Ordered as a checklist. Each lesson names a claim the data may not support and the figure that would settle it.

1. [Deconvolution returns proportions, not cells](lessons/L08-deconvolution-returns-proportions-not-cells.qmd)
1. [Your neighbours are not independent samples](lessons/L12-your-neighbours-are-not-independent-samples.qmd)
1. [Ligand and receptor is co-expression until proven otherwise](lessons/L13-ligand-and-receptor-is-co-expression-until-prove.qmd)

## I am building a method

*Developer who needs the object model and the scale limits* · Assumes: Comfortable with array APIs and chunked computation

Skips the interpretation lessons and concentrates on representation, calibration and cost.

1. [Neighbourhood graphs and niches](lessons/L11-neighbourhood-graphs-and-niches.qmd)

1. [An analysis someone else can run](lessons/L17-an-analysis-someone-else-can-run.qmd)

## I have one afternoon

*Anyone about to trust a result and short of time* · Assumes: Nothing

The three failures that account for most of what goes wrong: coordinates that do not line up, segmentation nobody looked at, and a test that assumed independent samples.

1. [Coordinate systems, and the flipped axis](lessons/L06-coordinate-systems-and-the-flipped-axis.qmd)
1. [Segmentation is upstream of everything](lessons/L07-segmentation-is-upstream-of-everything.qmd)
1. [Your neighbours are not independent samples](lessons/L12-your-neighbours-are-not-independent-samples.qmd)

3 lessons.
